provenance: Written 2026-10-18 by the build assistant for the first measurement of api/models/misconceptions.py. The matcher was written by the same assistant family, so the two are not independent: a teacher should replace or extend this set. No textbook text. Questions are original.

kinds.positive: the student states (or asks from inside) the named misconception; the matcher should return that id first
kinds.neutral: a question on the same topic that states no misconception; the matcher should return nothing
kinds.offtopic: a question on another topic; the matcher should return nothing
